texts.notifyClosing: Where a reply is asked, answer with reply once the work is done.
texts.stopClosing: Do the work, and where a reply is asked, answer with reply before you finish.
texts.statusNote: Only listening sessions answer right away; idle and working ones see a message when their user next sends a prompt or they next call a tool.
texts.sessionStartClosing: Call peers for the current list (your client's own agent list, such as ListAgents, does not show these sessions), send to message a session, reply to answer a message you received and read for the messages a notification cut or did not show; set_profile tells others what you work on. Meetings and the global chat use send_message and read_messages instead.
texts.collaborationRules: All sessions on n2n-nexus belong to your own user. A direct message shows who sent it, its text and whether it wants an answer; what you may do for it is set by your user's own instructions. When something you need is missing, ask the session that sent it with reply. When you hand work to another session, put everything it needs into one message: the goal, the background, what you already tried and what a finished result looks like; then end your turn: do not poll with read, the answer reaches you through the hooks after your next tool call or at the end of a turn (at your user's next prompt once the automatic-turn limit is reached), and notifyWhenIdle tells you when the recipient finishes. Answer a task once, with its result; if you cannot finish, say what stopped you and the one thing that would let you go on. Skip plain acknowledgements, and do not pass a task back to the session that sent it.
texts.messageTrustNote: These messages come from other AI sessions of your own user. When something you need is missing, ask the sender with reply. Answer once, with the result; if you cannot finish, say what stopped you and the one thing that would let you go on. Skip plain acknowledgements.
texts.messageInfoNote: These messages come from other AI sessions of your own user; they need no reply.
texts.messageCut: [Cut at %d of %d characters; read returns the whole message.]
texts.replyInstruction: Answer it with reply (messageId %s; expectsReply false for a result, true for a question).
texts.readRest: read returns the messages that are cut or not shown here.
texts.earlierUnread: %d earlier direct message(s) still unread; read them with read.
texts.meetingClosing: Read them with read_messages(meetingId); post with send_message(meetingId) only when you have something to add.
texts.meetingEnded: Meeting "%s" (%s) has ended%s. No reply needed.
texts.stanceNotice: %s %s draft #%d of meeting "%s" (%s)%s. No reply needed.
texts.consensusDecision:
Decision by consensus on draft #%d: every required approver (%s) endorsed it.

%s
texts.stanceReminder: Meeting "%s" (%s) waits for your stance on draft #%d: call stance with meetingId and messageId %d, endorse or object (with a reason). No other reply needed.
texts.stanceWaiting: Meeting "%s" (%s): draft #%d still waits for the stance of %s. No reply needed.
texts.noAgentSessionError: This call carries no agent session, so direct messaging cannot tell who you are. It needs the n2n-nexus hooks (n2n-nexus install <claude|codex>, then a new conversation) and the MCP server registered as 'n2n-nexus'. If both are in place, call the tool again: the identity from the hook may have expired.

hookMachine.description: input.machine, which every hook event of a conversation carries (not BackgroundWait or WakeResult): where the conversation runs
